# railway_bucket (Resource)

A Railway storage bucket registered in an environment. Region changes replace the bucket. Railway may retain a deleted bucket internally for a delayed permanent-deletion period.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "railway_bucket" "cache" {
  project_id     = railway_project.example.id
  environment_id = railway_project.example.default_environment_id
  name           = "terraform-example-cache"
  region         = "ams"
}

output "bucket_reference" {
  value = railway_bucket.cache.references["BUCKET"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String)
- `name` (String) Bucket display name and Railway reference namespace.
- `project_id` (String)
- `region` (String)

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Railway bucket ID.
- `references` (Map of String) Safe Railway reference expressions. These are references, never bucket credentials.

Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
